caption: The drawing depicts a woman with dark hair styled up, wearing an off-the-shoulder white dress that includes ruffled sleeves and a corseted bodice. Across her body, draped from her left shoulder and around her lower half, is a greenish-blue cloth. She is adorned with a necklace of dark beads. Her skin tone is light brown, and she is shown from the thigh up, with her body slightly angled to the left and her head turned further in that direction. Her right arm crosses her chest, with her hand touching her left shoulder, while her left arm hangs downward. At the bottom of the figure, instead of feet, there is a stylized yellow and brown object. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or scenery present. The colors used in the drawing consist primarily of earth tones, muted greens, and yellows, contributing to a subdued, natural palette.
title: Figurehead
